info.title: WhatsUp Gold
info.description: Progress WhatsUp Gold is a network, server, and application monitoring platform. This spec covers WhatsUp Gold's v1 RESTful API for managing monitored devices, device groups, credentials, device roles, and monitors.

dynamicToken.name: Authorization
dynamicToken.description: WhatsUp Gold OAuth2-style password-grant token, retrieved dynamically by POSTing form-urlencoded credentials to /api/v1/token. Itential Platform extracts the token from the 'access_token' response field and replays it on the Authorization header of every subsequent request. WhatsUp Gold's documented header format is 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' -- since Itential Platform's dynamic-retrieval apiKey mechanism replays the extracted value verbatim (with no built-in prefix templating), confirm on your target platform version whether the 'Bearer ' prefix needs to be added manually.

type.description: Credential type, e.g. SNMP v1/v2/v3, WMI, SSH, Telnet, ADO, VMware.

DeviceProperties.description: Free-form device property bag (key/value pairs configured on the device).
